item.title: Ambient Weapon: The Archaea Loki
item.description: video upload by S1gns Of L1fe Modular "This video showcases the power and versatility of the Archaea Loki module, a compact analog synth voice designed for serious sound design and ambient exploration. With rich modulation, dual oscillators, and a custom filter, Loki is more than a synth voice — it is an ambient weapon."

item.title: Infinite Machinery Eurorack: A Sleeper Brand in Musical Context
item.description: video upload by S1gns Of L1fe Modular "In this video I explore a selection of Infinite Machinery Eurorack modules in real musical context, focusing on stable FM, expressive filtering, and patch-efficient utilities that support creative flow. You’ll hear practical patch ideas and see how these modules translate into dependable, musical results you can apply to your own system."

item.title: Can’t Believe How Good the MicroKorg Is
item.description: video upload by The Unperson "In this video I revisit the legendary Korg MicroKorg — a synth that has remained one of the best-selling hardware instruments for over two decades.
